og.description: By default, this site collects nothing about you. No cookies, no trackers. The tools run in your own browser, and the form only sends anything when you submit it.

blocks.html: Short and exact, as it should be: what this site takes from you, and what it doesn't.
Just reading the pages? Then this site collects nothing about you. There's no account, no newsletter, and no hidden form quietly watching.

Our hosting service may keep technical server logs, such as IP addresses, for security. We don't use those logs to track you or market to you, and the site itself has no analytics, no cookies and no tracking pixels.

Nothing is sent until you press "Send it to us" yourself. What goes is only what's in the fields: your name, email, the service, your message, and how you'd like us to reply. We use them only to reply and talk about your project. We don't sell them, and we don't pass them on.

Where it goes: the form service of our host (Netlify Forms), and a notification lands in dadmor's email. We keep messages only as long as we need them to reply and discuss your project, and they're never sold or passed on.
If the form can't send, for example before the site is published, you'll see a notice, and WhatsApp works just as well.

The project estimator and the security self-check run entirely in your own browser. They don't send your answers anywhere, and they don't store them. Close the page or press "Clear all answers" and they're gone. Printing and copying only happen when you choose them.

The only thing kept is your theme choice, light or dark, and it stays in your own browser (localStorage). It's never sent to us. Switching language just changes the page address and stores nothing. Tool answers are never stored.
Even the fonts are hosted here, not pulled in from an outside service.
If we ever add analytics, it'll be a privacy friendly tool, such as Plausible or Umami, and this page will be updated before it goes live.
Any question, or want a message you sent us deleted? Email hello@dadmor.com, use the contact form, or WhatsApp (+98 939 140 0826).
